title: Maya's Toy Box Art Show
segments: Maya loved making 'toy box photos' in the community art club. She carefully arranged small toys and objects, taking creative pictures. Today, she finished her very first project: a tiny space scene! Ms. Chen saw it and invited Maya to present it at the club's showcase.
